CO1: Generate a BIP39 recovery code from entropy and derive its seed, and say how many words a given amount of entropy gives
CO2: Explain what a wallet database holds, which of its contents a seed can reproduce and which cannot
CO3: Derive keys along a BIP32 path, read any path, and say what the holder of an extended public key can and cannot do
CO4: Compare the recovery code schemes and the implicit and explicit path solutions, and justify a choice for a given user
CO5: Check a chapter's statements against the standards and against independent software, and say which is right
_note: These chapter objectives serve the course outcomes LO-5 and LO-4. LO-5, to compare wallet and recovery designs - deterministic derivation, recovery codes, key stretching and salts, secret sharing, output descriptors, multisignature - and to judge what each costs and protects when a key or a backup is lost or stolen, names six mechanisms, and each is a concept of this chapter; comparing the recovery-code schemes and the implicit and explicit path solutions and justifying a choice for a given user is that outcome's judgement half, and saying which of a wallet database's contents a seed can reproduce and which it cannot is its loss half. Deriving keys along a path, reading any path, and saying what the holder of an extended public key can and cannot do serves LO-4 as well, on deriving keys and addresses from the standards and checking each result against a reference implementation or a published vector, because the derivation this chapter performs is the standard's own and every result is checked against its published vectors and against Bitcoin Core's own output. The ten course outcomes these objectives are aligned to are a DRAFT awaiting the owner's approval: 01-outcomes/sen0401_outcomes_v1_0_0.ttl states, in its own provenance header and in its rdfs:comment, that the outcomes are not approved and that the owner is asked to confirm, revise or reject each one. The alignment below is therefore provisional in the same way, and will be re-stated once the outcomes are ruled on.
